[title] PagedAttention + speculative decoding: 2.4x goodput at p99
[body] KV-cache fragmentation: <4% waste via block tables
[body] Draft model acceptance alpha = 0.78 at gamma = 5
[body] Continuous batching; chunked prefill off to hold the TTFT SLO

novice.takeaway: The presenter is describing specific technical methods and measurements used to achieve a 2.4x improvement in performance for serving AI models.
questions: What do 'alpha' and 'gamma' values mean here?
What is the TTFT SLO exactly?
Why is chunked prefill turned off?
novice.inferred_claim: The presenter wants me to believe their specific technical optimizations reliably produce the claimed 2.4x performance gain.

peer.inferred_claim: These specific techniques (paged memory, speculative decoding, batching tradeoffs) are what drove the 2.4x goodput improvement.

expert.takeaway: Combining PagedAttention's memory efficiency with speculative decoding and tuned batching/prefill settings yields the claimed 2.4x p99 goodput gain.
